name: BAROAK
fullName: BAROAK — Craft Kitchen, Botanical Bar & Lounge
heroHeadline: Where Artisanal Gastronomy Meets Unhurried Oak Elegance
heroSubheadline: A refined sensory sanctuary in Sector 15A Noida. Immerse yourself in warm oak aesthetics, handcrafted botanical mixology, wood-fired delicacies, and soulful dining.
about: BAROAK was conceived as an unhurried retreat from the frenetic pace of NCR. Designed with deep oak textures, supple cognac leather, ambient amber lighting, and a lush outdoor terrace, we invite you to savor thoughtful conversations, progressive North Indian fusion, artisanal wood-fired fare, and Pan-Asian artistry.

gallery.title: The Oak Lounge
